items.title: Fast-Food & Snack Desk: Heinz Is Releasing The Weirdest New Product Of 2026
items.summary: We’ve got a buzzer beater! Just when you thought you wouldn’t see the release of any more weird products from food brands this year, Heinz went and got one in at the last second. And we have thoughts about it. What’s the product? Napkins made from football jersey material. Why? Well, I wish I had a good answer to this question.

items.title: Culver's: Every Culver's Sandwich, Ranked Worst To Best

items.title: Wendy's: Wendy’s Is Turning Its Frostys And Fries Into Holiday Gifts
items.summary: I wonder how many times you have to visit a fast food restaurant before your family starts buying you its merchandise for Christmas. I imagine once the drive-thru staff know your order without having to ask, you’re probably a prime candidate. Well, Wendy’s has decided its most dedicated customers deserve something to unwrap this year.

items.title: IHOP: IHOP Just Announced Its First Ever Collectible Mug
items.summary: It’s not just you. Holiday collectibles are having a moment. Between blind boxes and collectible cups, they’ve even started to take over the food industry. They’re so prominent that one restaurant is joining in on the fun for the first time ever. Who’s the restaurant in question? None other than IHOP! IHOCHM The International House of Pancakes?
